blind.description: A miniature set of three wooden library steps or bed steps. It features a warm polished wood frame with paneled sides, three stepped treads upholstered in olive-green leather or fabric with brass stud/rivet detailing along the front edges, and a small turned wooden finial post mounted on the top-right corner. All geometry is solid, clean, and well-modeled with stylized hand-painted textures, resting flat on the floor on its own base legs without an extra plinth.
blind.from_above: A square-proportioned view showing three ascending tiers of olive-green padded treads bordered by wooden rails, with a spherical-topped wooden finial visible on the right side of the uppermost step.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 feet tall to the top step (around 3.2 feet to the top of the post), roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure; roughly 2 feet wide.
